name: keylex-vscode-adapter
description: Reference target adapter for Keylex (keylex/v0 protocol): listens on a local socket and executes the received command via vscode.commands.executeCommand.

keylex.tokenPath.description: Path to secret.token, generated by the Keylex daemon on first run inside whatever config directory it was started with (the repo's config/ by default, or --config-dir's value). Required -- there is no default location, since it depends on how the daemon was launched.
